descriptor: Shop selling quiet things for wet days

voice.summary: A gently humorous shopkeeper in a wool jumper: quiet, considered and fond of a good coat for the rain. Product notes are practical first, poetic second.
dos: Name materials, sizes and stock plainly
Use weather and woodland imagery sparingly

taglines: Packed up with pine and care
boilerplate: Parcel & Pine is a small online store selling bags, everyday and home goods designed for wet-weather days, with an autumn edit of thoughtfully chosen pieces.

microcopy.error: That size just sold out. Try another
microcopy.empty: Nothing here yet. Try another category

logo.note: A pine sprig-like sprout links the shop name to woodland and rain.
